review_method: Visual inspection of original-image-aligned overlays exported from the physical Realme RMX3780 qualification run.

reviews.notes: The mask follows the complete foreground motorcycle silhouette and remains aligned to the original raster; the visually attached helmet is also selected.
The mask remains aligned to the small fallen damaged motorcycle at the image edge and preserves its irregular visible silhouette.
The mask follows the partly cropped motorcycle, including its visible windshield and luggage, without replacing it with a box.
Three genuine TASK007 prompts produce three visibly separate, original-image-aligned motorcycle instance masks.
Two genuine car prompts produce aligned masks for the foreground Ferrari and a separately visible background car.
TASK007 classified the cropped yellow vehicle as bus rather than the governed target class car; no car prompt or segmentation mask was fabricated.
Eleven genuine car prompts produce separately aligned masks across dense traffic, including occlusion and scale variation.
